# cato_private_apps (Data Source)

Retrieves private applications (ZTNA private access apps).

## Example Usage

```terraform
## Providers ###
provider "cato" {
  baseurl    = "https://api.catonetworks.com/api/v1/graphql2"
  token      = var.cato_token
  account_id = var.account_id
}

### Data Source Usage ###

# Example: Read all private applications
data "cato_private_apps" "all" {}

# Example: Read private applications by name
data "cato_private_apps" "by_name" {
  name_filter = ["WIKI", "Demo Portal"]
}

# Example: Read private applications by ID
data "cato_private_apps" "by_id" {
  id_filter = ["12345", "67890"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id_filter` (List of String) List of private application IDs to filter
- `name_filter` (List of String) List of private application names to filter

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of private applications (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `allow_icmp_protocol` (Boolean) Whether ICMP is allowed to the application
- `connectivity_status` (String) Connectivity status
- `description` (String) Description
- `id` (String) ID
- `internal_app_address` (String) Internal application address (IPv4 or FQDN)
- `name` (String) Name
- `probing_enabled` (Boolean) Whether connectivity probing is enabled
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the application is published
